  • Class
    Description
    LeastConnectionsStrategy
    Routes to whichever replica currently has the fewest in-flight requests — better than round-robin when request cost varies (some inputs are more expensive than others), since it naturally avoids piling more work onto a replica that's already busy with a slow request.
    LoadBalancingStrategy
    Picks which replica in a ReplicaPool should serve the next request.
    ReplicaAutoScaler
    Automatically scales a ReplicaPool's replica count up or down based on average in-flight requests per replica — the "automatic scaling" piece of the Distributed Model Serving roadmap item.
    ReplicaHandle
    Pairs one replica engine instance with an in-flight request counter — the same technique LifecycleManager's package-private EngineHandle uses for graceful hot-swap draining, made public here since LoadBalancingStrategy implementations need to read in-flight counts to make routing decisions (e.g.
    ReplicaPool
    A pool of InferenceEngine instances — all the same model version — load-balanced across via a LoadBalancingStrategy.
    RoundRobinStrategy
    Cycles through replicas in order — the simplest strategy, and the right default when replicas are homogeneous and requests are roughly uniform cost.
